messages:
Maya: SCIM sync in prod throwing 403s since 08:42 UTC. Sidecar logs show KMS Decrypt AccessDenied. Anyone touching key policies during the RBAC cleanup?

David: I see the same. CloudTrail shows kms:Decrypt AccessDenied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/prod-scim-key, principal role/service-account-svc. This lines up with PR #842 changes.

Nina: Can you paste the log lines? Which IAM principal is the app assuming?

David: Logs: ```2026-03-23T08:42:13Z scim-sidecar ERROR kms=AccessDeniedException key=alias/prod-scim-key principal=arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/service-account-svc```

Ashley: Checked key policy history 108:39 UTC there was an edit that added a Deny block scoped to cross-account roles. It accidentally matched our service-account role.

Maya: If it's a key policy Deny, IAM permissions won't help. Need to revert the key policy change now.

Ashley: Reverting key policy patch: keypolicy-2026-03-23-08:39 -> reverted. Console shows Deny removed for service-account-svc.

audit-bot: Audit event recorded: key-policy-revert user=Ashley id=kp-revert-1713301180

David: Note: sidecar caches DEKs on startup. If it failed to decrypt earlier it may need a restart. Rolling restart now: `kubectl -n scim rollout restart deploy/scim-sidecar`

Maya: Pods are restarting. Tailing logs.

David: New pod log: decrypt succeeded, SCIM sync resumed (12 users provisioned).

Nina: Root cause: RBAC cleanup PR indirectly caused a key policy Deny. Action items: 1) add key-policy diff check to RBAC PR checklist, 2) CloudWatch alarm for KMS Deny events on prod keys -> PagerDuty, 3) run an audit of recent key policy edits.

Maya: I'll open the postmortem and assign owners. Also add a runbook step: restart sidecar if KMS bootstrap fails.

Ashley: For vuln triage, we'll also review the removed principals to ensure we didn't remove any necessary cross-account allow statements.

David: Closing INC in 30m if steady. Thanks. :thumbsup:

audit-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0323-88 assigned=eng-security severity=high
